2025-05-21
Claimant reported a sideswipe that occurred while changing lanes on a multi-lane road, with the other vehicle moving
into the claimant's lane and making contact along the passenger side. The claimant is unrepresented and provided an
initial statement by phone, describing neck and back pain beginning shortly after the impact.
2025-06-21
Reviewed the photos submitted by the claimant and the damage pattern on the vehicle, which lines up with the
described impact along the side panels and mirror. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the start of coverage. The driver is shown as a named driver on the policy.
2025-07-20
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the lane change and the contact between the two vehicles. Two
independent witnesses in nearby vehicles gave statements that macth the claimant's account of how the collision
happened.
2025-09-16
Medical records show the claimant was seen for neck and back strain, with the type and level of injury fitting the force
of a side impact. No prior injury to the same body areas is on record. Treatment followed a typical course and eased
off as the claimant improved.
2025-10-25
The cliamant has given the same account of the accident in every conversation so far. It is not yet fully clear from the
statements and photos exactly where in the vehicle the claimant was seated at the moment of impact, so I have
requested a follow-up question on seating position.
2025-11-27
Based on the photos, witness statements, the other driver's confirmation, and the medical picture, the claim is
consistent across sources and I am recommending it proceed to standard settlement review, with the seating position
question noted as the only open item.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
